answer: Bindings are kept in quill, verified in jade, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history therefore fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 4 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the dawn check. A farm of 4625 identities would post 1522 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
